text:
emma: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR with the SDK snippet updates and a migration guide for v0.7 -> v0.8. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Need 2 reviewers and a merge slot before the release cutoff (Thu May 6 16:00 UTC).
ryan: I can take a review after standup. Is this doc-only or does it reference new feature flags?
sasha: Will need to know if this should be behind the `enable_new_tokenizer` flag in the examples. If it touches behavior we should gate the merge until the flag rollout.
emma: Good call — the SDK examples mention the tokenizer change but the migration guide clearly shows how to opt out. It's doc-only (no runtime changes), but users will hit confusing errors if docs and SDK snippets are out of sync.
marco: Can we target a merge window on Tue May 4 evening? Release team prefers docs merged before final canary so docs-preview links in the release notes are stable.
ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #4823: linkcheck error in migration.md line 42 — broken link to /sdk/auth. Full log: https://ci.internal/docs-build/4823/logs
emma: thanks CI log — that link was a relative path leftover. Pushed a fix in the same PR (force-push). Also added YAML frontmatter for versioning.
ryan: Quick pass: code snippets look good. One nit: update the `auth` snippet to use `ClientConfig` instead of `Config` (old alias). I'll post an inline comment.
sasha: If it's doc-only, I can approve once the `enable_new_tokenizer` note is more prominent — users who upgrade will see different tokenization. Maybe add a short callout: "If you see token mismatch..."
emma: added callout and highlighted it with a warning block. Also added this minimal frontmatter at top:
```yaml
---
version: 0.8
sidebar_position: 3
---
```
vishal: Release note — cutoff is strict at Thu May 6 16:00 UTC, but small doc-only fixes can be merged up to 24h before if release eng signs off. If you want an exception, ping me with the diff and I'll approve.
emma: requesting exception: doc-only, affects SDK onboarding for new customers, prevents broken links in release notes. Ping @vishal for approval.
marco: I can hold a merge slot Tue May 4 18:00 PT if approvals + green CI. That gives us a nice window before the final canary.
docs-bot: Reminder: add `sitemap: true` in frontmatter for versioned pages or the site will omit it from the v0.8 nav.
emma: added `sitemap: true` and pushed. Also fixed the `auth` import per @ryan.
ci-bot: docs-preview build triggered for PR #4823.
ci-bot: docs-preview succeeded — snapshots and linkcheck passed. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/docs-build/4823/artifacts
ryan: LGTM — approved. :thumbsup:
sasha: approved. :white_check_mark: — added a small follow-up to expand the tokenizer troubleshooting section in a subsequent PR.
vishal: exception granted for doc-only change. Merge allowed before cutoff. Please ensure changelog entry references docs PR number.
emma: thanks all. I'll merge at Tue May 4 18:00 PT (will @marco to press merge if I'm offline).
marco: happy to merge at 18:00 PT once approvals, green CI, and vishal sign-off are present.
docs-bot: Merging blocked until protected-branches checks pass: required status "release-cooldown" is not set.
emma: I've requested release-cooldown from release-engineers. ETA 10m.
ci-bot: protected-branch check cleared.
marco: merging now.
marco: merged PR #4823 into main — deploying docs preview and invalidating CDN.
emma: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short note for the release notes team to include the migration guide link.
ryan: nice one.
sasha: cheers :tada:
